question.text: A number is called a palindrome if it reads the same backward as well as forward. For example <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>285582</mn></math> is a six digit palindrome. The number of six digit palindromes, which are divisible by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>55</mn><mo>,</mo></math> is ________.

solution.text:
Palindrome Numbers only in this form will be divisible by 55.

Numbers can be  between 0-9

Number of ways of selecting value of a=P110

Similarly  number of ways of choosing value of b=P110  (As a and b can also be same)

Therefore, Total number of ways of getting palindrome numbers divisible by 55 is =1×10×10×1=100
